text: The purpose of this report is to fill a vacancy on the Employee and Labour Relations Committee resulting from the resignation of Councillor Chin Lee.

City Council on June 26, 27, 28 and 29, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council the appoint Councillor Mary-Margaret McMahon to the Employee and Labour Relations Committee for a term ending November 30, 2018 and until a successor is appointed.
